# Shop API
The annual report exposes payments posted in a calendar year. A split checkout allocates one payment across several lines.
Reservations can expire after a process interruption. Booked allocations are persistent in this fixture's store.
Run `bun test`. All data and amounts are synthetic integer cents.
smoke.test.ts:
import {test,expect} from 'bun:test';import {payments,reset,booked} from './payments';import {annualReport} from './report';import {splitCheckout} from './checkout';
test('report and split',()=>{reset();payments.push({id:'one',posted:true,paidAt:'2025-12-28',cents:100});expect(annualReport(2025).cents).toBe(100);splitCheckout('one',[40,60]);expect(booked.size).toBe(2);});
